heading: About Me
subheading: Backend developer who enjoys turning business requirements into reliable, admin-friendly websites.
bio: I'm Rajesh Mahanta, a backend developer currently working at Inflexi Technologies Private Limited. My day-to-day work revolves around managing e-commerce websites — handling inventory, creating, updating, editing and deleting products, and keeping all of a website's data accurate and up to date.

Alongside store management, I build custom CMS projects from scratch: admin dashboards that let clients control their content, bookings and payments themselves. I've built complete CMS-driven websites for a photography studio, a real-estate business, a temple (Ved Mandir), a solar company, and a visitor management system.
I like clean database design, predictable APIs and admin panels that non-technical people actually enjoy using.

points: Manage e-commerce websites on BigCommerce and WooCommerce.
Handle inventory and product lifecycle — create, update, edit and delete products and bulk data.
Maintain and update all website data and content for clients.
Design and develop custom CMS projects and admin panels.
Built full CMS websites with booking systems and online payment.
Developed a visitor management system for tracking and reporting entries.
Handled the complete stack — database, backend, admin panel and frontend.

values.title: Reliable
values.text: Data integrity first — validated inputs, clean schemas, safe updates.

values.title: Admin-friendly
values.text: Every site I build can be managed by the client without a developer.

values.title: Practical
values.text: Simple, maintainable code that ships and keeps working.
